# uzc_account_balance (Data Source)

Reads the current UzCloud account balance and usage summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_account_balance" "current" {}

output "available_balance" {
  value = data.uzc_account_balance.current.available_balance
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `all_time_usage` (Number)
- `available_balance` (Number)
- `available_free_credits` (Number)
- `available_net_balance` (Number)
- `charged` (Number)
- `current_month_usage` (Number)
- `current_usage` (Number)
- `deposited` (Number)
- `due` (Number)
- `free_credit_balance` (Number)
- `hourly_usage` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `usage` (Number)
